```yaml
name: Bump OpenInference Instrumentation Version

on:
  release:
    types: [published]
    tags: ['openinference-instrumentation@*']
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      package:
        description: 'Package to bump (openinference-instrumentation or openinference-semantic-conventions)'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options:
          - openinference-instrumentation
          - openinference-semantic-conventions

jobs:
  bump-version:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Get package name and version from tag
        id: get_version
        run: |
          TAG_NAME="${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}"
          PACKAGE_NAME="${TAG_NAME%@*}"
          VERSION="${TAG_NAME##*@}"
          
          echo "package_name=$PACKAGE_NAME" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "version=$VERSION" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "tag_name=$TAG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Update dependency versions in Python packages
        run: |
          # Find all pyproject.toml files in python/instrumentation directories
          find python/instrumentation -name "pyproject.toml" -type f | while read -r file; do
            echo "Processing $file"
            # Update the dependency version using sed
            if [ "$PACKAGE_NAME" = "openinference-instrumentation" ]; then
              sed -i "s/\(openinference-instrumentation\s*=\s*\){[^}]*}/\1>=${VERSION}/" "$file"
            elif [ "$PACKAGE_NAME" = "openinference-semantic-conventions" ]; then
              sed -i "s/\(openinference-semantic-conventions\s*=\s*\){[^}]*}/\1>=${VERSION}/" "$file"
            fi
          done

      - name: Add missing lower-bound pin for openinference-semantic-conventions in google-genai instrumentor
        run: |
          FILE="python/instrumentation/openinference-instrumentation-google-genai/pyproject.toml"
          if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
            echo "Adding lower-bound pin for openinference-semantic-conventions in google-genai instrumentor"
            sed -i '/openinference-semantic-conventions/s/=/>=/' "$FILE"
          fi

      - name: Create Pull Request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: bump ${{ env.package_name }} to ${{ env.version }}"
          title: "chore: bump ${{ env.package_name }} to ${{ env.version }}"
          body: |
            This PR was automatically created to bump the minimum version of `${{ env.package_name }}` to `${{ env.version }}` across all Python instrumentor packages.
            
            This ensures that all instrumentors use at least the newly released version of the dependency.
            
            Fixes: #<issue-number-if-applicable>
          branch: bump-${{ env.package_name }}-${{ env.version }}
          base: main
          delete-branch: true
```
